{{Quote|However, the best (and cheapest) way to sample the authentic flavors of Lianna is to eat on the street&mdash;fish sticks baked in choya and lill and served on a plastic stick, Bubble Bowls of VegeParsine, fresh choya bread and Dalkash ale.|''How to Do the Allied Tion on 25 Credits a Day'' lists Liann street food|<ref name="MTL" />}}
'''Fish sticks''' were a type of [[Ocean/Legends|seafood]] available following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They were sold, along with other [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and beverages such as [[Bubble Bowl]]s of [[Vegeparsine|VegeParsine]], [[choya bread]] and [[Dalkash ale]], on the streets of the [[Lola Curich Starport|starport]] in [[Lola Curich]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on the primarily [[Human/Legends|Human]]-populated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. Fish sticks consisted of [[Fish/Legends|fish]], baked in the cooking additive [[lill]] and [[choya]], and served on a [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] stick. According to the travel guide ''[[How to Do the Allied Tion on 25 Credits a Day]]'', the sticks were cheap and a good way to sample the authentic cuisine of Lianna.<ref name="MTL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fish sticks were first mentioned in ''[[Mission to Lianna]]'', an adventure written by [[Joanne E. Wyrick]] and released in [[1992]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="MTL" /> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Fish finger|fish fingers]] are a frozen seafood often associated with [[Wikipedia:Great Britain|British]] cuisine.<ref name="BRITAIN">{{WebCite|url=http://www.foodsofengland.co.uk/fishfingers.htm|text=Fish Fingers|author=Hughes, Glyn|date=2018-09-2|archivedate=20190420224152}}</ref>
